payload.body: Durable copy of the three lane items from the consumer inventories (2026-10-31). (1) WP02b: the candidate ref is pushed to the project's GitHub remote only, found by its URL against release.repo, never cfg_release_first_remote's answer: Intent's first remote, local, is a push-only mirror where no CI runs; the tag on green goes to every remote in release.remotes. (2) WP08: the built-in formula carries Intent's 0634 cask sha check, gives brew smoke a home (an after: command or a formula verb), and carries Utilz's tap-pull rule (their post-cut:111-123, ST0030: pull this Mac's tap clone after the publish). (3) WP02c: the new issue on a cut whose after: commands run to the end leaving the RELEASE seal with no verdict (.errors still 'run in flight'; Utilz 2.14.8's tmp/release/20261030-2059.RELEASE.* is the evidence, its .out ending on post-cut's last line). Also approved: your eight reds fixed as one order. FYI only -- no response needed.
